description:
Minimal, Docker-free Quarkus app that adds the quarkus-scheduler extension on top of the
        bootui-quarkus extension and proves the Scheduled Tasks panel light-up: @Scheduled methods discovered at
        build time by the deployment processor's Jandex scan are recorded into a synthetic QuarkusScheduledTasks
        bean, mapped by QuarkusScheduledTaskProvider onto the neutral ScheduledTaskDto contract, and surfaced on
        GET /bootui/api/scheduled, with the panel reported available in the manifest. Kept separate from
        bootui-quarkus-integration-tests (which deliberately has NO scheduler) so the scheduler-absent
        unavailable path and the scheduler-present capture path are each proven in isolation — the same split
        used for the Micrometer-present/absent, SmallRye-Health-present/absent and OpenTelemetry-present/absent
        coverage.
